title: ORD results metadata
description: Captures metadata about an ORD analysis result set, including analysis identification, model information, event set details, output summary levels, exposure summary, and grouping context. The schema is structured as a mandatory platform-neutral core with two optional extension blocks: platform_settings (generic, structured fields for cross-platform concepts such as PLA, disaggregation, and correlation modelling — any platform populates the fields it supports) and vendor_settings (free-form vendor/key/value triples for anything not otherwise captured). Schema v2 incorporates ORD working group feedback through September 2026 including GroupMethod codes, nullable event_set fields, platform-neutral perspective_code handling, and the platform_settings/vendor_settings rescoping (previously oasis_platform/vendor_extensions) to keep ORD decoupled from any single implementer.

summary_set.title: Summary set
summary_set.description: Describes a summary level and the ORD outputs produced for it.

id.title: Summary ID
id.description: Identifier for the summary set, corresponding to SummaryId in ORD output files.

description.title: Summary description
description.description: Human-readable label for this summary level (e.g. 'Res', 'Com', 'Total'). Corresponds to SummaryDescription in ORDB.

grouping_fields.title: Grouping fields
grouping_fields.description: Fields used to group losses for this summary level. For OED-based analyses these are OED field names (e.g. ['LOB']); for other exposure standards (CEDE, EDM) these are the corresponding field names from that standard. Corresponds to SummaryField in ORDB.

oed_fields.title: OED fields (deprecated alias)
oed_fields.description: Deprecated alias for grouping_fields retained for backward compatibility. Use grouping_fields in new implementations.

ord_output.title: ORD outputs produced
ord_output.description: Flags indicating which ORD output files were produced for this summary set.

elt_moment.title: ELT (Moment)
elt_moment.description: Moment Event Loss Table was produced.

elt_sample.title: ELT (Samples)
elt_sample.description: Sample Event Loss Table was produced.

elt_quantile.title: ELT (Quantile)
elt_quantile.description: Quantile Event Loss Table was produced.

plt_moment.title: PLT (Moment)
plt_moment.description: Moment Period Loss Table was produced.

plt_sample.title: PLT (Samples)
plt_sample.description: Sample Period Loss Table was produced.

plt_quantile.title: PLT (Quantile)
plt_quantile.description: Quantile Period Loss Table was produced.

alt_period.title: AAL (Period)
alt_period.description: Period Average Annual Loss table was produced.

alt_meanonly.title: AAL (Mean Only)
alt_meanonly.description: Average Annual Loss table without standard deviation was produced.

ept_full_uncertainty_aep.title: EP - Full Uncertainty AEP
ept_full_uncertainty_aep.description: Full uncertainty aggregate exceedance probability curve was produced.

ept_full_uncertainty_oep.title: EP - Full Uncertainty OEP
ept_full_uncertainty_oep.description: Full uncertainty occurrence exceedance probability curve was produced.

ept_mean_sample_aep.title: EP - Mean Sample AEP
ept_mean_sample_aep.description: Mean sample aggregate exceedance probability curve was produced.

ept_mean_sample_oep.title: EP - Mean Sample OEP
ept_mean_sample_oep.description: Mean sample occurrence exceedance probability curve was produced.

ept_per_sample_mean_aep.title: EP - Per Sample Mean AEP
ept_per_sample_mean_aep.description: Per-sample mean aggregate exceedance probability curve was produced.

ept_per_sample_mean_oep.title: EP - Per Sample Mean OEP
ept_per_sample_mean_oep.description: Per-sample mean occurrence exceedance probability curve was produced.

psept_aep.title: PSEPT - AEP
psept_aep.description: Per Sample Exceedance Probability Table (aggregate) was produced.

psept_oep.title: PSEPT - OEP
psept_oep.description: Per Sample Exceedance Probability Table (occurrence) was produced.

qelt.title: QELT
qelt.description: Quantile Event Loss Table (quantile-based EP variant) was produced.

qplt.title: QPLT
qplt.description: Quantile Period Loss Table (quantile-based EP variant) was produced.

output_set.title: Output set
output_set.description: Describes the outputs produced for a given loss perspective. The perspective_code and exposure_summary_level_fields together define the compatibility criteria for grouping analyses.

perspective_code.title: Perspective code
perspective_code.description: Loss perspective for this output set. Used as a compatibility key for grouping analyses. Well-known Oasis/OED values are 'gul' (ground-up loss), 'il' (insured loss), 'ri' (reinsurance net — the cedant's loss retained after reinsurance recoveries), and 'rl' (reinsurance loss — the ceded amount recovered from reinsurers, as distinct from 'ri'). Other modelling platforms may use different conventions; the value should be consistent within a grouping operation.

exposure_summary_level_fields.title: Exposure summary level fields
exposure_summary_level_fields.description: Fields used to define exposure summary levels for this output set. Used as a compatibility key for grouping analyses. For OED-based analyses these are OED field names; for other exposure standards, the equivalent field names from that standard.

summaries.title: Summary sets
summaries.description: Summary sets produced for this output set.

alpha_by_model.title: Alpha by model
alpha_by_model.description: Gaussian copula correlation alpha value specified at the model level.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: Gaussian copula correlation parameter for this model.

alpha_by_summary.title: Alpha by model and summary level
alpha_by_summary.description: Gaussian copula correlation alpha value at the model + perspective + summary level.

tiv_by_coverage.title: TIV by coverage type
tiv_by_coverage.description: Total insured value broken down by coverage type. Standard OED types (buildings, other, contents, bi) are always included; extended types are zero-filled where not applicable.

exposure_summary_peril.title: Exposure summary for a peril
exposure_summary_peril.description: Exposure counts and TIV for a single peril. All count fields should always be emitted and zero-filled where not applicable.

version.title: Results metadata schema version
version.description: The schema version for results metadata validation.

analysis_id.title: Analysis ID
analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis result set. The naming convention may differ between platforms (e.g. Oasis uses 'analysis_id'; other vendors may use different identifiers). This field captures the platform-native identifier verbatim.

source_tag.title: Source tag
source_tag.description: Labels the origin of the analysis (e.g. platform or portfolio name).

model_supplier_id.title: Model supplier ID
model_supplier_id.description: Identifier for the model vendor/supplier. Used as a compatibility key for grouping analyses.

model_name_id.title: Model name ID
model_name_id.description: Identifier for the model used to produce these results.

model_version.title: Model version
model_version.description: Version of the model used to produce these results.

created_at.title: Created at
created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime at which the analysis was run (e.g. 2026-05-01T12:00:00Z).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code(s) of the output losses. Expressed as an array to accommodate multi-currency outputs (e.g. grouped analyses combining results across jurisdictions run in different currencies). For a single-currency analysis, supply an array of one element.

number_of_samples.title: Number of samples
number_of_samples.description: The number of samples generated per event in this analysis. Meaningful for stochastic (STOC) analyses; may be absent or zero for analytical (ANLM) or convolution (CONV) methods.

loss_methods.title: Loss methods
loss_methods.description: LossMethod codes present in the ORD output files for this analysis (e.g. ['STOC', 'ANLM']). Allows downstream consumers to determine available LossMethods without reading potentially large output files.

items.title: LossMethod code
items.description: Short code identifying the loss calculation method. Known values: MEAN (analytical mean; formerly ANLM in ORD v1), STOC (stochastic sampling), CONV (numerical convolution). Note: MEAN/ANLM is not valid as a GroupMethod — GroupMethods operate on STOC and/or CONV inputs only.

ep_methods.title: EP methods
ep_methods.description: EPMethod codes present in the ORD output files for this analysis (e.g. ['A_MEAN', 'S_FULL', 'S_PSMN']). Allows downstream consumers to determine available EPMethods without reading potentially large output files.

items.title: EPMethod code
items.description: Short code identifying the EP calculation method. Known values: A_MEAN (analytical mean), S_FULL (stochastic full uncertainty), S_PSMN (stochastic per-sample mean), S_MEAN (stochastic mean), C_MEAN (convolution mean), C_PARA (convolution with parametric uncertainty).

c_para_distribution_type.title: C_PARA distribution type
c_para_distribution_type.description: The parametric distribution type used when EPMethod C_PARA is present. This field is required if 'C_PARA' appears in ep_methods. The value should identify the distribution clearly (e.g. 'Beta', 'Gamma'). The field is intentionally free-form rather than a fixed enumeration to allow for additional distributions without schema changes.

event_set.title: Event set
event_set.description: Identifies the event set and occurrence set used in this analysis. These fields contribute to GroupEventSet identification in grouped analyses. All properties are nullable so that a GroupEventSet ID can be generated on any subset of populated fields; the subset used is controlled by the group_event_set_fields parameter (see ORD Combining Results §7.2). Where a field is not applicable or not known, it should be populated as null rather than omitted.

event_set_id.title: Event set ID
event_set_id.description: Locally unique identifier of the event set file used in the analysis. Null if not applicable or not recorded.

event_set_description.title: Event set description
event_set_description.description: Human-readable description of the event set. Null if not applicable or not recorded.

event_occurrence_id.title: Event occurrence ID
event_occurrence_id.description: Locally unique identifier of the occurrence set file used in the analysis. Null if not applicable or not recorded.

event_occurrence_description.title: Event occurrence description
event_occurrence_description.description: Human-readable description of the occurrence set. Null if not applicable or not recorded.

event_occurrence_max_periods.title: Event occurrence max periods
event_occurrence_max_periods.description: The timespan of the occurrence set expressed as a number of periods. Directly constrains the minimum valid group_number_of_periods in a grouped analysis; absence or null is a functional gap for grouping operations. Null if not applicable or not recorded.

items.title: Peril code
items.description: A peril identifier code. For OED-based analyses these are OED three-letter peril codes (e.g. 'WSS', 'ORF'). Other exposure standards may use different codes.

peril_filter.title: Peril filter
peril_filter.description: Peril codes the analysis was filtered to. The code format depends on the exposure standard in use (see exposure_standard). Absent if no filter was applied.

exposure_standard.title: Exposure standard
exposure_standard.description: The exposure data standard used for the input portfolio. Well-known values: 'OED' (Open Exposure Data), 'CEDE' (Moody's/AIR), 'EDM' (RMS/Verisk). Other values are permitted for platforms using proprietary standards.

output_sets.title: Output sets
output_sets.description: The output sets produced by this analysis, one entry per loss perspective (e.g. GUL, IL, RI).

exposure_summary.title: Exposure summary
exposure_summary.description: Summary of the exposure processed in this analysis, keyed by peril code. For OED-based analyses keys are OED three-letter peril codes (e.g. 'WSS', 'ORF'); for other exposure standards the equivalent peril codes from that standard are used. All count fields should be emitted and zero-filled where not applicable.

grouping.title: Grouping settings
grouping.description: Settings relating to ORD grouped analysis. Populated when this analysis is part of, or a candidate for, a grouped result. Grouped output tables (GPLT, GALT, GEPT) use a GroupMethod code rather than an EPMethod code; return periods in grouped tables are determined by relative frequency of group events rather than EP curve construction.

group_methods.title: Group methods
group_methods.description: GroupMethod codes present in the grouped ORD output files (e.g. ['RSAM', 'RSSD']). Analogous to loss_methods and ep_methods for grouped results. GroupMethod describes how group event losses are derived from underlying per-model event losses. Note: the analytical mean (LossMethod MEAN, formerly ANLM) is explicitly excluded as a GroupMethod — all GroupMethods operate on stochastic (STOC) and/or convolution (CONV) loss inputs only. The GroupMethod–LossMethod relationship is non-exclusive: all three GroupMethods can combine STOC and CONV inputs; RSSD additionally requires decomposed event standard deviations.

items.title: GroupMethod code
items.description: Short code identifying the group loss calculation method. Known values: MEAN — Grouped Means (group losses derive from summed/maximum event mean of underlying analyses); RSAM — Resampled secondary uncertainty (group event losses from summed/maximum of resampled losses from underlying event severity distributions; inter-GroupEventSet correlation is zero or imposed by alpha factors); RSSD — Resampled secondary uncertainty using sum of decomposed event standard deviations (group event losses from resampled losses; group event standard deviations from summing of decomposed correlated and independent standard deviations capturing internally derived correlation by event; requires decomposed event standard deviations in input ELTs).

group_event_set_id.title: Group event set ID
group_event_set_id.description: Identifier for the event set group this analysis belongs to. Analyses sharing a group_event_set_id have compatible event sets and can be grouped. Determined by model_supplier_id and other configurable metadata fields. The internal structure of this identifier may vary between platforms — implementations should treat it as an opaque string for comparison purposes rather than assuming a specific format.

group_number_of_periods.title: Group number of periods
group_number_of_periods.description: Number of periods used in the grouped analysis. Must be at least the largest number of periods across all event sets being grouped (see event_set.event_occurrence_max_periods).

group_elt_format_selection.title: Group ELT format selection
group_elt_format_selection.description: Which ELT format is used for loss severity sampling in the grouped analysis.

group_fill_perspectives.title: Group fill perspectives
group_fill_perspectives.description: Whether missing perspectives are filled from available ones during grouping (e.g. net produced from gross).

was_filled.title: Was filled
was_filled.description: Whether this output set's perspective was filled from another perspective during grouping (e.g. net filled from gross). Allows downstream consumers to detect fills without inferring from perspective codes.

source_perspective.title: Source perspective
source_perspective.description: If was_filled is true, the perspective code of the source used to fill this output set. See output_set.perspective_code.

global_alpha.title: Global alpha
global_alpha.description: Global Gaussian copula correlation parameter applied across all models in the group. Overridden by alpha_by_model or alpha_by_summary where specified.

alpha_by_model.title: Alpha by model
alpha_by_model.description: Correlation alpha values at the model level, overriding global_alpha for those models.

alpha_by_summary.title: Alpha by model and summary level
alpha_by_summary.description: Correlation alpha values at the model + perspective + summary level. Takes precedence over alpha_by_model and global_alpha.

platform_settings.title: Platform settings
platform_settings.description: Optional block of generic, structured fields for cross-platform concepts (PLA, disaggregation, correlation modelling) that don't belong in the platform-neutral core because not every platform models them, or models them the same way. Any platform populates the fields it supports and leaves the rest absent. Renamed from oasis_platform in an earlier draft — these fields were originally identified from Oasis LMF's implementation, but are described generically here so any platform can use them, keeping ORD decoupled from any single implementer.

oed_version.title: OED schema version
oed_version.description: The OED schema version of the input exposure file - 'major.minor.patch' format (e.g. 2.0.0 or v2.0.0). Only applicable when exposure_standard is 'OED'.

pla.title: Post Loss Amplification applied
pla.description: Whether Post Loss Amplification was applied to the losses.

pla_settings.title: PLA settings
pla_settings.description: Post Loss Amplification settings, if pla is true.

do_disaggregation.title: Disaggregation applied
do_disaggregation.description: Whether OED disaggregation was applied to split terms and conditions for aggregate exposure.

join_summary_info.title: Summary info joined
join_summary_info.description: Whether summary info data was joined to output files.

correlation_settings.title: Correlation settings
correlation_settings.description: Hazard and damage correlation settings used in the analysis. Populate this where a platform's correlation model exposes these parameters (e.g. Oasis LMF's internal correlation model); other platforms may apply correlation within the model before output and have nothing to report here.

vendor_settings.title: Vendor settings
vendor_settings.description: Optional free-form array of vendor/key/value triples for platform-specific fields not covered by the platform-neutral core or platform_settings. Vendors (Moody's, Verisk, RMS, etc.) add one entry per field they want to report. Mirrors the VendorExtension table in the relational model (analysis_id, vendor, key, value). Renamed and restructured from vendor_extensions (previously a nested object keyed by vendor name) in an earlier draft. Fields added here will be considered for promotion to the core schema or to platform_settings in future versions if they have broad applicability.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: Identifies the vendor or platform this setting belongs to (e.g. 'verisk', 'moodys').

key.title: Key
key.description: The setting's name, in whatever convention the vendor uses.

value.title: Value
value.description: The setting's value. Free-form string — encode structured values (e.g. as JSON text) if needed.
